description: This file defines the EntityWhereString class, which represents a raw SQL string condition used in constructing database queries within the OFBiz framework, specifically for the entity engine. It provides methods to retrieve the SQL string, check if it's empty, and implements the EntityCondition interface to be used as a condition object within the ORM.

classes.name: EntityWhereString
classes.description: A final class implementing EntityCondition that encapsulates a raw SQL string used as a condition in entity queries. It provides methods to access the SQL string, check condition validity, and integrates with the visitor pattern for condition processing.

methods.name: EntityWhereString
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EntityWhereString with the provided raw SQL string.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the stored SQL string is empty or null.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Returns the embedded SQL string for use in query construction.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Performs any validation required; in this case, does nothing and always assumes the condition is valid.

methods.name: entityMatches
methods.description: Unsupported operation; raises exception as SQL evaluation isn't performed.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Unsupported operation; raises exception as SQL evaluation isn't performed.

methods.name: getWhereString
methods.description: Returns the raw SQL condition string.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns itself, as the object is immutable.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor following the visitor pattern for condition processing.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another EntityWhereString object based on the SQL string.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the SQL string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the object, which is the raw SQL string.
